name: Distro 10 - (5g) Baller Bucket - Sour Diesel
description:
Fresh-frozen flavor, bulk size. The Distro 10 Sour Diesel Baller Bucket packs a full 5 grams of live resin — full-spectrum concentrate extracted from fresh-frozen flower to lock in the terpenes and aroma the plant started with. Bold, flavorful, and built for people who go through it.

Sour Diesel is a legendary sativa-dominant strain and one of the most recognizable names in cannabis. Expect its signature profile: sharp, pungent diesel up front cut with zesty citrus and earthy undertones, finished with that unmistakable sour bite. Because it's live resin, every dab hits with deeper flavor and a fuller, more well-rounded effect — a fast, energizing lift that sparks focus and creativity, making it a standout daytime pick.

Why you'll love it:

5G live resin — bulk value in one bucket, fresh-frozen extraction for maximum terpene preservation
Full-spectrum flavor — rich, aromatic, and true to the strain
Signature Sour Diesel flavor — sharp pungent diesel with zesty citrus and earth
Bucket packaging — easy to scoop, easy to store, ready to dab

Big flavor, premium potency, and true-to-plant character in every gram. Distro 10 Sour Diesel is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets. Requires a compatible dab rig or vaporizer.
